recommended_smallest_architecture.decision: Add only a specific data-only Monster visual NotifyState for actual sequence/non-Action consumers. Reuse the current rendering implementation through a stateless extraction; keep Action lifetime and hit provenance unchanged. Existing AKZMonster owns narrow mesh-local resource receipts. No manager/component/FSM/duplicate gameplay states.
recommended_smallest_architecture.engine_first: Use stock PlayParticleEffect only for verified nonlooping simple particles whose transform/scale policy matches; stock TimedParticleEffect only if overlap and source-policy audit proves sufficient. These do not cover the entire reported source set.
recommended_smallest_architecture.shared_spawn_reuse: Move only existing Action StartCombatEffect pure spawn/transform/floor/parameter/decal work into a stateless function on existing KZAnimNotify_CombatEffect class/file. Data-only means no Pawn/component/runtime state on notify assets. Action wrapper preserves active/avatar/conditional guard and weak records/timer/dedup/cleanup. New state calls same factory; do not duplicate the300-line presenter or broaden IsActive guard into a bypass.
recommended_smallest_architecture.new_specific_state: Possible UKZAnimNotifyState_MonsterVisualEffect h/cpp: immutable source data/Instanced existing effect records plus exact reported trail/bone/material channels. Normal queued NotifyBegin/Tick/End, NoMergeOnConcurrentPlay enabled; per-state runtime is not stored on shared UObject.
recommended_smallest_architecture.runtime_key: Mesh + originating AnimInstance + EventReference.GetNotifyInstanceID. UE5.8 supplies and propagates this ID, distinguishing concurrent montage/asset-player contexts. Reject INDEX_NONE and foreign/stale mesh/anim context rather than inventing one shared bool. Source EventId remains provenance, not the sole runtime receipt key.
recommended_smallest_architecture.existing_owner: AKZMonster receives Begin/Update/End for its actual mesh; only finite weak resource receipts and material baseline/last-written values are stored. These are presentation ownership receipts, not gameplay state copies. Attached world PSCs, trail UStaticMeshComponent and MID writes are created with existing engine APIs; no new runtime component class is needed.
recommended_smallest_architecture.loop: A full-cycle active NotifyState naturally retains one engine instance/resource through a continuous loop; a closed partial window naturally produces new Begin/End receipt on a later loop. Do not permanently dedup by source EventId across loops. Cross-fade/concurrent same asset uses NoMergeOnConcurrentPlay source IDs.
recommended_smallest_architecture.natural_vs_cancel: Use FAnimNotifyEndDataContext.bReachedEnd where present to distinguish source interval closure and early removal. Source explicit destroy/deactivate/detach flags govern normal End. Early cancel, source replacement, UnPossess, EndPlay and final freeze clear only owned resources and stop persistent emission; preserve source finite world residual/decal lifespan according to existing policy. Missing end reason is conservative cleanup, not assumed natural completion.
recommended_smallest_architecture.cleanup_hooks: Targeted Monster visual clear in existing UnPossessed/EndPlay and immediately before FinishDeathPresentation bPauseAnims. Never clear the paired victim solely on first Dead tag; wait existing final-freeze boundary. NotifyEnd must remain idempotent after explicit clear and never kill Player/another actor resources.
recommended_smallest_architecture.minimum_file_surface: Potential existing6runtime files: KZActionAbility h/cpp, KZAnimNotify_CombatEffect h/cpp, KZMonster h/cpp; new specific NotifyState2runtime files only if source mapping confirms demanded channels. Existing Exhaustion/Brutal/AI/ASC/AnimInstance require no gameplay rewrite. This is a proposal; parent owns final frozen Source baseline and implementation.
recommended_smallest_architecture.why_not_move_to_GameplayAbility: Moving Action presenter into GameplayAbility serves Exhaustion but still cannot serve ABP/no-Ability clips, so it is not the smallest complete solution. Deriving Exhaustion from Action would change forced-reaction blocking/cancel/activation semantics and is rejected.
recommended_smallest_architecture.authoring_once: Prefer sequence-level windows for Monster clips when retimed source-to-current mapping is verified, so the same actual clip works under ComboAction, Exhaustion and controlled library playback. Do not also duplicate equivalent montage FX markers. Preserve existing gameplay notify GUIDs and montage/sequence timing. Parent metadata audit decides source ranges/occurrences.
recommended_smallest_architecture.preview_boundary: A Monster-owned adapter covers actual Monster BP mesh playback without needing AI. Default asset-editor preview owners are not AKZMonster; generic animation-editor preview support would need a mesh-local receipt owner and must be declared separately if requested, not silently claimed by a Monster-only runtime.

YetugaSurfaceTrail.proposal: Spawn an engine StaticMeshComponent for the exact source mesh; attach to actual valid socket with verified current mesh scale conversion; apply exact material parameter/intensity. Existing NotifyState ticks own temporal visual modulation, then ends/cleans its own component. BlendTime interpretation/fade shape is native-unconfirmed until source evidence; no arbitrary trail or fade duration. Any residual blend-out needs component-bound owned timer or inside-window curve, with explicit cancellation cleanup.
YetugaSurfaceTrail.current_gap: PSC/decal presenter has no static-mesh resource path.

ApesSetBoneLocationToMaterialParam.proposal: Use GT NotifyTick and current actual bone/socket world or component transform in verified source coordinate space; write exact original vector parameter/material target. Store only per-owned parameter baseline/last-written receipt and restore safely on End/cancel/freeze. No AnimInstance combat state or worker Actor/MID access.
ApesSetBoneLocationToMaterialParam.current_gap: No live bone-vector parameter writer; exact coordinate/target material semantics require source field review.

ApesSetMaterialParamByCurve.engine_option: If exact scalar parameter name, curve channel/time origin, target material set and blend semantics match, author original scalar keys as a material-flagged animation curve. Engine applies named scalar params on materials and optionally leader-pose followers; absent curves restore material defaults. This can avoid a custom scalar runtime tick.
ApesSetMaterialParamByCurve.when_not_equivalent: An inline notify-local curve, target-specific/nondefault reset, vector parameter or source custom interpolation not equivalent to blended animation curve requires the narrow NotifyState scalar path. Preserve original time/key/tangent/weight data and state any project adapter.
